home.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
home.faq.q1.question: Is ImgFeel really free?
home.faq.q1.answer: Yes, ImgFeel is completely free to use. There are no hidden fees, subscriptions, or premium tiers.
home.faq.q2.question: Are my images uploaded to a server?
home.faq.q2.answer: No. All image processing happens directly in your browser. Your images never leave your device, ensuring complete privacy.
home.faq.q3.question: What image formats are supported?
home.faq.q3.answer: ImgFeel supports JPG, PNG, and WebP formats for resizing.
home.faq.q4.question: Is there a file size limit?
home.faq.q4.answer: There is no strict file size limit. However, very large images may take longer to process depending on your device.
home.faq.q5.question: Can I use ImgFeel on my phone?
home.faq.q5.answer: Yes, ImgFeel is fully optimized for mobile devices. You can resize images directly from your phone or tablet.
